base.description: The g4poc FP8 base = PA's r03 (BASELINE-FP8.md, jumanzii/g4poc-a ac6035c07f): text-only compressed-tensors FP8 checkpoint (G4POC_MODEL_DIR default), FP8 KV, Triton attention + Triton fused_moe (default config), chunked prefill 4096. Same flags as baseline/serve.sh r03; PA launched from e3e4acf268, whose python/ is identical to this commit.

nvfp4-smoke.description: Harness smoke only (2026-10-04, coordinator-approved while the FP8 base is not up): gemma4nv's NVFP4 base, run with G4POC_MODEL_DIR at the NVFP4 snapshot. Never a g4poc result.

c1-moe-tuned.description: C1: base + a fused_moe Triton config tuned on the bs2 RTX 5090 (fp8_w8a8 per-channel, E=128, N=704; compute/moe_tune.py, merged by compute/merge_moe_configs.py). Only the MoE tile configs change.

c3-lpm.description: C3a: base + --schedule-policy lpm (longest cached prefix first among waiting requests; fcfs on the base). Scheduling order only; only matters when requests queue, i.e. from about 16 in flight on the base.

c3-cp2048.description: C3b: base + --chunked-prefill-size 2048 (4096 on the base). Halves the per-forward prefill tokens and the prefill activation transient; the KV pool is unchanged at mem 0.93.

c2-extend-tiles.description: C2-A: base + the sm120 FP8-KV Triton extend tiles (SGLANG_OPT_TRITON_EXTEND_SM120_FP8_KV_TILES=1; table from compute/extend_attn_bench.py: head_dim 512 (32, 32, 64, 8, 1), 256 (32, 32, 32, 4, 1)). Python differs from base's commit only in extend_attention.py and environ.py; with the env off it runs the base's tiles.
